eventLocation: The confluence of three rivers, Thirumukkudal
eventName: Creating awareness among the public about using yellow bags instead of plastic bags.
eventDescription: The ?Vithaigal? volunteer organization, together with Triveni Academy School and the ?Nammal Mudiyum? team of Puthiya Thalaimurai TV, conducted a clean-up drive along the Palar riverbank today. During this activity, over 500 kilograms of plastic waste were collected.
